subheadline.id: Membangun AI dan software kelas production untuk perbankan, fintech, dan enterprise.

bio.en: I am a Forward Deployed AI Engineer based in Jakarta, with 4+ years building production systems for digital banking, fintech and enterprise SaaS. Since February 2026, I have led Azure-native AI delivery at Metrodata for 12+ enterprise clients across banking, automotive, mining, food manufacturing and consumer health. My work spans multi-agent RAG, realtime voice, document AI and code security. Before that, I built backends and full-stack products at MNC, Jatis and Jenius. Getting an LLM response is only part of the job: I use evaluation to decide what to ship, guardrails to keep the system within its limits, and observability to understand production failures.
bio.id: Saya Forward Deployed AI Engineer di Jakarta, dengan pengalaman 4+ tahun membangun sistem production untuk perbankan digital, fintech, dan SaaS enterprise. Sejak Februari 2026, saya memimpin pengembangan platform AI berbasis Azure hingga rilis di Metrodata untuk 12+ klien enterprise di berbagai sektor, antara lain perbankan, otomotif, pertambangan, manufaktur makanan, dan consumer health. Proyeknya mencakup asisten RAG multi-agent, voice agent realtime, document AI, dan keamanan kode berbasis AI. Sebelumnya, saya membangun backend dan produk full-stack untuk e-commerce, travel, SaaS, dan perbankan digital, termasuk di MNC, Jatis, dan Jenius. Saya membuat sistem LLM andal di production lewat evaluasi, guardrail, dan observability.

story.en: I started with Android development at a vocational school in Malang and opened my GitHub account in 2016. Through school and Telkom University, I earned 20 competition placings, including seven first places, across chatbot prototypes, data science and capture-the-flag. I helped lead a 200-student programming club, trained an IndoBERT model for campus sentiment analysis and supported myself with part-time e-commerce backend work. Roles at MNC, Jatis and Jenius took me into travel payments, multi-tenant SaaS and digital-banking integrations. I joined Metrodata's Microsoft AI practice in 2026. Today I write specs, direct AI coding agents in parallel and review their work before merging. The problems are concrete: let a caller interrupt a voice agent, make an AI-generated security fix reviewable, or stop document AI from guessing. Alongside that, I build Indonesian-language Terminal-Bench tasks for LILT AI to test how frontier agents handle Indonesian conventions. In both kinds of work, evaluation matters more than a convincing demo.
story.id: Saya mulai belajar pengembangan Android di SMK di Malang dan membuka akun GitHub pada 2016. Selama sekolah dan kuliah di Telkom University, saya meraih 20 prestasi kompetisi, termasuk tujuh juara 1, melalui beragam proyek, dari prototipe chatbot hingga data science dan capture-the-flag. Saya ikut memimpin klub programming beranggotakan 200 mahasiswa, melatih model IndoBERT untuk analisis sentimen kampus, dan membiayai kebutuhan saya lewat pekerjaan backend e-commerce paruh waktu. Di MNC, Jatis, dan Jenius, saya membangun sistem pembayaran travel, SaaS multi-tenant, dan integrasi perbankan digital. Pada 2026, saya bergabung dengan tim Microsoft AI di Metrodata. Kini saya menulis spec, mengarahkan AI coding agent secara paralel, dan meninjau hasilnya sebelum merge. Saya membangun voice agent yang dapat disela di tengah kalimat, platform keamanan yang membuka fix PR, dan document AI yang tidak boleh menghasilkan jawaban tanpa dasar. Di samping itu, saya membangun task Terminal-Bench berbahasa Indonesia untuk LILT AI yang menguji apakah AI agent frontier mampu menangani konvensi Indonesia. Hasil evaluasi menentukan perubahan yang saya rilis.

howIWork.en: I start each feature with a written spec and acceptance criteria. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Codex implement much of the code in parallel; design, review, verification in a deployed environment and the merge decision remain mine. Gold sets, A/B tests, CI gates and shadow mode help me decide whether a change works, not just whether it runs. I report the measurement method with each metric and keep exact logic in deterministic code. An LLM feature is not finished until it has evaluation, guardrails and observability.
howIWork.id: Saya menetapkan setiap fitur dalam spec tertulis dengan acceptance criteria. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, dan Codex mengerjakan sebagian besar implementasi secara paralel; saya tetap bertanggung jawab atas desain, review, verifikasi di environment yang sudah di-deploy, dan merge. Saya mengevaluasi perubahan dengan gold set, A/B test, CI gate, dan shadow mode, serta menyertakan metode pengukuran saat melaporkan metrik. Logika yang harus pasti tetap berada di kode deterministik, dan fitur LLM baru dianggap selesai setelah dievaluasi, dilengkapi guardrail, dan dapat dipantau.

title.en: How I run AI in production
title.id: Cara saya menjalankan AI di production

intro.en: When an AI feature fails, I need to see where and why. I instrument the Azure services I run with OpenTelemetry, mostly through the Azure Monitor distro. That covers Python (FastAPI and Functions) and Node (Next.js) on App Service, Functions and Container Apps.
intro.id: Saya menyiapkan observability sebagai bagian dari fitur sejak awal. Layanan AI yang saya jalankan di Azure memakai instrumentasi OpenTelemetry, sebagian besar lewat distro Azure Monitor, pada Python (FastAPI, Functions) dan Node (Next.js) di App Service, Functions, dan Container Apps.

points.id: genai-telemetry

text.en: Each model call records its model, provider, agent and token usage, including reasoning and cached tokens. This lets me trace cost and latency back to the feature that caused them.
text.id: Setiap panggilan model mencatat pemakaian token (termasuk reasoning dan cached token), model, provider, dan agent, sehingga biaya dan latensi bisa ditelusuri per fitur.

points.id: alerts-as-code

text.en: Alert rules, action groups and diagnostic settings live in Bicep next to the app and ship with azd: 44 rules in production today, covering daily and month-to-date spend, reasoning-token spikes, 429 throttling per deployment, judge latency and failed evaluation gates.
text.id: Alert rule, action group, dan diagnostic setting ditulis di Bicep bersama aplikasinya dan dirilis dengan azd: 44 rule aktif di production saat ini, mencakup biaya harian dan bulan berjalan, lonjakan reasoning token, throttling 429 per deployment, latensi judge, dan evaluation gate yang gagal.

points.id: telemetry-governance

text.en: Personal data is redacted before telemetry leaves the app. I sample noisy spans and cap daily ingestion, with an alert at 80 percent of the cap.
text.id: Data pribadi disamarkan sebelum diekspor. Saya menerapkan sampling pada span yang menambah noise dan membatasi ingestion per hari, dengan alert saat mencapai 80 persen.

points.id: self-hosted

text.en: For a ticketing marketplace backend, I provisioned Prometheus and Grafana as code. Black-box probes check the public API every 5 seconds, alongside Postgres, Redis and host metrics.
text.id: Untuk backend marketplace tiket, saya menyiapkan Prometheus dan Grafana sebagai kode, dengan black-box probe ke API publik setiap 5 detik serta metrik Postgres, Redis, dan host.

outro.en: This site follows the same approach: an anonymous performance beacon, nightly performance runs and public visit stats in the Lobby's Visitor Observatory.
outro.id: Situs ini juga dipantau: beacon performa anonim, uji performa setiap malam, dan statistik kunjungan publik di Observatorium Pengunjung di Lobby.

Gangguan SAP tidak boleh menghentikan portal. Business owner memberikan arahan mingguan, termasuk revisi proses yang disetujui pengguna di tengah proyek dan memindahkan seluruh alur kerja ke purchase order. approach.en: I isolated SAP behind a provider port with retries, rate limits and a circuit breaker so ERP delays cannot cascade into the portal. The port and the tax invoice check currently serve seeded data.
approach.id: Saya mengisolasi SAP di balik provider port dengan retry, rate limit, dan circuit breaker agar keterlambatan ERP tidak merembet ke portal. Saat ini, port tersebut dan pengecekan faktur pajak masih menyajikan data seed.

problem.en: Serupa needed its own ticketing platform: organizers publish events with ticket tiers, attendees find events and get free or paid tickets online, and every order ends in a ticket that can be shown at the door. Two freelance engineers built it as three apps between June and August 2025.
problem.id: Serupa membutuhkan platform ticketing sendiri: penyelenggara memublikasikan acara dengan beberapa tier tiket, pengunjung mencari acara dan mendapatkan tiket gratis maupun berbayar secara online, dan setiap pesanan berakhir dengan tiket yang bisa ditunjukkan di pintu masuk. approach.en: I set up the API on Express 5 and Bun with routes, controllers, services and repositories over PostgreSQL and Drizzle, plus Helmet, rate limiting, structured logs, seed data and GitHub Actions deploys.

approach.en: I built accounts and events in the API: JWT access and refresh tokens, email verification and password reset, user and admin roles, event search with filters, a Redis event cache with invalidation, rate-limited view counts and S3 uploads for event covers and profile photos.
approach.id: Saya membangun fitur akun dan acara di API: access token dan refresh token JWT, verifikasi email dan reset password, peran user dan admin, pencarian acara dengan filter, cache acara di Redis dengan invalidasi, penghitungan view dengan rate limit, serta upload cover acara dan foto profil ke S3.

approach.en: I built the attendee site in Next.js with TanStack Query, from event discovery and search to event pages with ticket tiers. It includes a free-ticket flow, checkout with a payment method choice, payment result pages and My Tickets with QR codes, plus SEO metadata and a sitemap.
approach.id: Saya membangun situs pengunjung dengan Next.js dan TanStack Query, dari penelusuran dan pencarian acara hingga halaman acara dengan tier tiket. Fiturnya mencakup alur tiket gratis, checkout dengan pilihan metode pembayaran, halaman hasil pembayaran, dan My Tickets dengan kode QR, beserta metadata SEO dan sitemap.

approach.en: I developed the organizer dashboard from a v0-generated scaffold, connecting sign-in, event creation, editing and listing to the API, with sub-categories and a location map.
approach.id: Saya mengembangkan kerangka hasil v0 menjadi dashboard penyelenggara. Login serta fitur pembuatan, pengeditan, dan daftar acara saya hubungkan ke API, lengkap dengan subkategori dan peta lokasi.

approach.en: My teammate built ticket orders and payments in the API: quota and per-user limits, payment links and callbacks for QRIS, cards, e-wallets and virtual accounts, PDF invoices, status emails and Socket.IO payment events. My checkout and My Tickets pages call those endpoints.

tagline.en: Grounded realtime voice AI: ~2 s to ~0.2 s interruption latency in a controlled A/B (n=4 calls per arm), knowledge-based answers and human handover.
tagline.id: Voice AI realtime dengan grounding dan handoff ke petugas. Latensi interupsi ~2 ke ~0,2 detik pada A/B terkontrol (n=4 panggilan per jalur), bukan trafik live.

role.en: Owner and lead engineer, responsible for design, AI coding agent direction, review and release
role.id: Owner dan lead engineer, bertanggung jawab atas desain, arahan AI coding agent, review, dan rilis

problem.en: MII's contact center needed an alternative to rigid phone menus: a voice agent with knowledge-base answers, interruption during speech or search, and human transfer and return within the same call. Supervisors needed a live console.
problem.id: Penelepon membutuhkan pengganti menu telepon yang kaku: voice agent yang menjawab dari knowledge base perusahaan, dapat disela saat berbicara atau mencari, dan beralih ke petugas lalu kembali dalam satu panggilan. Supervisor membutuhkan console live.

approach.en: I combined two team prototypes, keeping a colleague's voice and indexing foundations, then ported realtime to Python and FastAPI. I owned the specs, review and releases, with AI coding agents helping implement them.
approach.id: Saya menyatukan dua prototipe tim, melanjutkan fondasi voice dan indexing dari rekan saya, lalu memindahkan realtime ke Python dan FastAPI. Spec, review, dan rilis saya tangani, dengan bantuan AI coding agent pada implementasi.

approach.en: I tracked audio playout and moved knowledge tools off the realtime loop into cancellable tasks with one deadline. Knowledge-turn interruption fell from ~2 s to ~0.2 s in a controlled A/B, n=4 calls per arm, not production traffic.
approach.id: Saya melacak audio playout dan memisahkan tool knowledge dari realtime loop ke task yang bisa dibatalkan dengan satu deadline. Interupsi saat pencarian turun ~2 s ke ~0.2 s pada A/B terkontrol, n=4 panggilan per jalur, bukan trafik produksi.

approach.en: I added atomic writes, crash recovery, replayable dead letters and drain-gated releases, with managed identity and infrastructure as code. Earlier Managed Application test installs passed 25/25 public and 22/22 private checks. A November install passed 27/27 automated checks, but first-admin sign-in, agent creation and browser calls still needed human validation.
approach.id: Saya menambahkan atomic write, crash recovery, replay dead-letter, dan rilis dengan drain gate, memakai managed identity serta infrastructure as code. Test install Managed Application sebelumnya lolos 25/25 pemeriksaan publik dan 22/22 privat. Instalasi November lolos 27/27 pemeriksaan otomatis, tetapi sign-in admin pertama, pembuatan agent, dan panggilan browser masih perlu diuji langsung.

approach.en: I documented the decision to replace a retiring voice service with self-hosted WebRTC media on zonal VMs, then verified failover through hard VM-stop drills.
approach.id: Saya mendokumentasikan keputusan mengganti layanan voice yang akan dihentikan dengan media WebRTC self-hosted di VM zonal, lalu memverifikasi failover melalui drill dengan mematikan VM secara paksa.

approach.en: I built a voice evaluation harness with a media emulator, golden questions and a calibrated LLM judge. Changes without supporting evidence stayed disabled.
approach.id: Saya membangun voice evaluation harness dengan media emulator, golden question, dan LLM judge terkalibrasi. Perubahan yang tidak didukung hasil evaluasi tetap saya nonaktifkan.

sublabel.en: Cancellable tools with a 2.5 s budget
sublabel.id: Tool yang bisa dibatalkan dengan batas waktu 2,5 detik

label.en: Knowledge-lookup interruption latency, controlled A/B (n=4 calls per arm)
label.id: Latensi interupsi akses knowledge base, A/B terkontrol (n=4 panggilan per jalur)

context.en: Controlled A/B on the same deployment, index and audio, n=4 calls per arm: 1,875 to 2,140 ms vs 93 to 220 ms.
context.id: A/B test terkontrol pada deployment, index, dan audio yang sama, n=4 panggilan untuk masing-masing jalur: 1.875 hingga 2.140 ms vs 93 hingga 220 ms.

label.en: Hard node-loss drills recovered caller-audible AI, with an interruption
label.id: Drill kehilangan node memulihkan suara AI, dengan jeda panggilan

context.en: After four root causes were fixed, AI audio resumed after 11.5 s and 13.0 s in two hard VM-stop drills, with context preserved. This was audible recovery, not seamless failover.
context.id: Setelah empat akar masalah diperbaiki, suara AI kembali dalam 11,5 detik dan 13,0 detik pada dua drill pemadaman VM, dengan konteks tetap tersimpan. Ada jeda yang terdengar, bukan failover tanpa putus.

label.id: Jawaban halusinasi dalam perbandingan model offline; quality gate mempertahankan model realtime dengan hasil lebih baik

context.en: Evaluated offline with a calibrated LLM judge; mean score 4.71 vs 4.28.
context.id: Dievaluasi secara offline dengan LLM judge terkalibrasi; skor rata-rata 4,71 vs 4,28.

label.en: Voice channel migrated from a retiring service; old path removed
label.id: Voice channel dimigrasikan dari layanan yang akan dihentikan; jalur lama dihapus

context.en: Live cut-over completed well before the announced 2028 retirement, removing about 20.5k lines from the old path.
context.id: Cut-over live selesai jauh sebelum jadwal penghentian layanan pada 2028, dengan penghapusan sekitar 20,5 ribu baris kode dari jalur lama.

situation.en: MII needed a voice agent that could answer from its knowledge base, listen when interrupted and bring in a human without ending the call. I inherited voice and indexing work from a colleague, brought the prototypes together, then led the realtime backend, evaluation and release work. A connected call was only the start: I needed to check what the caller actually heard.
situation.id: MII membutuhkan voice agent yang menjawab dari knowledge base, bisa disela, dan dapat mengalihkan percakapan ke petugas tanpa menutup panggilan. Saya melanjutkan fondasi voice dan indexing dari rekan saya, menyatukan prototipenya, lalu memimpin pengembangan backend realtime, evaluasi, dan rilis. Panggilan yang berhasil tersambung belum cukup; saya perlu memeriksa apa yang benar-benar didengar penelepon.

title.en: Moved knowledge lookups out of the realtime loop
title.id: Memindahkan akses knowledge base keluar dari realtime loop

why.en: A knowledge lookup must not stop the system from hearing a caller. I moved lookups into cancellable tasks under one time budget and made interruption account for audio still waiting to play, not just the model's response state.
why.id: Interupsi penelepon saat pencarian berlangsung harus langsung diproses. Karena itu, akses knowledge base saya jadikan task yang dapat dibatalkan dengan satu batas waktu bersama, sementara barge-in memperhitungkan audio yang masih diputar.

title.en: Replaced a retiring voice service with self-hosted WebRTC on zonal VMs
title.id: Mengganti layanan suara yang akan dihentikan dengan WebRTC self-hosted di VM zonal

why.en: The managed service was being retired, so I kept the agent logic and changed the media path. Hard VM-stop drills recovered the call with context intact, but callers still heard a gap. Later install checks covered release integrity, not a rerun of the failed call-setup gate.
why.id: Layanan managed akan dihentikan, jadi logika agent saya pertahankan dan jalur medianya saya ganti. Drill pemadaman VM berhasil memulihkan panggilan beserta konteksnya, tetapi penelepon tetap mendengar jeda. Pemeriksaan instalasi berikutnya menguji integritas rilis, bukan mengulang gate setup panggilan yang sebelumnya gagal.

title.en: Built an evaluation harness before shipping changes
title.id: Membangun evaluation harness sebelum merilis perubahan

why.en: I used a media emulator, golden questions and a calibrated LLM judge to test changes against rules set in advance. A plausible improvement was not enough: changes without supporting evidence stayed disabled.
why.id: Saya menggunakan media emulator, golden question, dan LLM judge terkalibrasi untuk mengevaluasi perubahan. Perubahan tanpa bukti pendukung tetap dinonaktifkan.

lesson.en: A written spec and a merged PR are not proof that a fix helped. Set the verdict rules before testing, accept the negative results, and remove what the data rejected.
lesson.id: Spec dan PR yang sudah di-merge bukan bukti bahwa sebuah perbaikan berhasil. Tetapkan kriteria pengujian lebih dulu, terima hasil negatif, dan hapus perubahan yang tidak didukung data.

summary.en: I measure what the caller hears, joining recorded audio on the real call path with backend telemetry for each turn.
summary.id: Saya mengukur dari sisi penelepon, lalu mencocokkan rekaman audio di jalur panggilan sebenarnya dengan telemetry backend tiap giliran.

points.en: Live WebRTC answer latency: P50 1,204 ms, P95 1,257 ms (n=6 turns, no tool calls). The model's end-of-turn wait takes about 520 ms, first audio 408 ms, and the media path about 136 ms.
points.id: Latensi jawaban WebRTC live: P50 1.204 ms, P95 1.257 ms (n=6 giliran tanpa tool call). Model menunggu akhir giliran sekitar 520 ms, menghasilkan audio pertama dalam 408 ms, dan jalur media menambah sekitar 136 ms.

points.en: Cancellable knowledge lookups share a 2.5 s budget. Search and embeddings each allow 1.5 s per attempt; retries inherit the remaining deadline and cannot start without enough time.
points.id: Task pencarian knowledge base bisa dibatalkan dan berbagi batas 2,5 detik. Search dan embeddings mendapat 1,5 detik per percobaan; retry hanya dimulai jika sisa waktunya cukup.

points.en: I kept search in the backend's geography after a live A/B cut retrieval P50 by 1,351 ms.
points.id: Search saya pertahankan di geografi backend setelah A/B live memangkas P50 retrieval sebesar 1.351 ms.

points.en: Across 84 calls, minimal reasoning saved 39 ms and a 500 ms server silence window saved 69 ms. Both missed pre-set thresholds. An end-of-turn model added 220 ms and stays off.
points.id: Dari 84 panggilan, reasoning minimal menghemat 39 ms dan jendela hening server 500 ms menghemat 69 ms. Keduanya gagal memenuhi ambang awal. Model deteksi akhir giliran menambah 220 ms dan tetap nonaktif.

limits.en: Small test samples, not production traffic. The largest delay, end-of-turn detection, sits inside the model service.
limits.id: Sampel test kecil, bukan trafik produksi. Jeda terbesar, deteksi akhir giliran, berada di dalam layanan model.

summary.en: Call-path dependencies have per-attempt timeouts, idempotent-only retries and breakers: 5 failures in 60 s, then a probe after 30 s. Readiness exposes breaker state.
summary.id: Dependensi panggilan memakai timeout per percobaan, retry hanya untuk operasi idempotent, dan breaker: 5 kegagalan dalam 60 detik, lalu probe setelah 30 detik. Statusnya terlihat di readiness.

points.en: Two self-hosted LiveKit nodes span availability zones. Every 5 s, routing selects the healthy, non-draining node with the fewest rooms for new calls.
points.id: Dua node LiveKit self-hosted berada di availability zone berbeda. Routing diperbarui tiap 5 detik; panggilan baru menuju node sehat dengan room paling sedikit yang tidak sedang drain.

points.en: Supervised bridge workers heartbeat every 2 s. A dead worker's calls rejoin a live worker; callers still present go to a human rather than being hung up.
points.id: Worker bridge diawasi dengan heartbeat 2 detik. Jika worker mati, panggilannya pindah ke worker aktif; penelepon yang masih terhubung dialihkan ke petugas, bukan diputus.

points.en: Fake-model chaos tests first passed 16 of 17 modes in 3 runs, then repeated the 16 passes across 20 iterations (region outage not applicable). Failed writes enter replayable dead letters; search/embedding failures use keyword search; admin API failure uses the last good agent config.
points.id: Chaos test model tiruan awalnya lolos 16 dari 17 mode dalam 3 run, lalu mengulang 16 kelulusan itu selama 20 iterasi (gangguan region tidak berlaku). Write gagal masuk dead-letter untuk replay; search/embedding gagal memakai keyword search; admin API mati memakai konfigurasi agent terakhir yang valid.

points.en: Admission control protects active calls: 429 for new calls at capacity or model throttling, 503 when a dependency breaker is open.
points.id: Admission control menjaga kapasitas panggilan aktif: panggilan baru menerima 429 saat penuh atau model di-throttle, dan 503 jika breaker dependensi terbuka.

points.en: A 44-call live handover drill traced failures to model throttling and a silently dropped response. Failed responses are now logged and retried.
points.id: Drill handover live 44 panggilan menemukan throttling model dan respons gagal yang dibuang tanpa jejak. Respons gagal kini dicatat dan di-retry.

limits.en: One backend instance, no zone redundancy, fallback model or second region. Regional DR is designed, not drilled. The reduced PoC setup gate still failed: 70/74 calls, below 99%; install checks do not replace it.
limits.id: Backend satu instance, tanpa zone redundancy, model cadangan, atau region kedua. DR lintas region belum di-drill. Gate setup PoC terbatas tetap gagal: 70/74 panggilan, di bawah 99%; test instalasi bukan penggantinya.

summary.en: I commit decision rules before measuring. Only a pass changes a default; unsupported changes stay off.
summary.id: Kriteria saya tulis dan commit sebelum pengukuran. Default hanya berubah jika lulus; perubahan tanpa bukti tetap nonaktif.

points.en: The real bridge runs against a deterministic media emulator, a no-cost fake realtime endpoint or a headless WebRTC caller for live tests.
points.id: Bridge sebenarnya diuji lewat media emulator deterministik, endpoint realtime tiruan tanpa biaya, atau penelepon WebRTC headless untuk test live.

points.en: Scenarios cover quiet turns, knowledge questions, interruptions, escalation, long pauses, Indonesian callers, 15 dB street noise and office noise with speakerphone echo.
points.id: Skenario meliputi giliran tenang, pertanyaan knowledge base, interupsi, eskalasi, jeda panjang, bahasa Indonesia, bising jalan 15 dB, dan bising kantor dengan gema speakerphone.

points.en: An LLM judge scores 16 EN/ID golden questions, 2 runs per model, from 1 to 5 for groundedness, correctness, completeness, language and brevity. Calibration on 10 hand-labelled items reached 0.8 per-item agreement and 1.0 on hallucination flags.
points.id: LLM judge menilai 16 golden question EN/ID, 2 run per model, pada skala 1 sampai 5: groundedness, correctness, completeness, bahasa, dan keringkasan. Kalibrasi 10 item berlabel manual mencapai kesesuaian 0,8 per item dan 1,0 untuk penanda halusinasi.

points.en: Turn-taking gates cover false end-of-turn, cut-offs, spurious events per 100 utterances and latency, with limits set before each run.
points.id: Gate turn-taking mengukur salah deteksi akhir giliran, ucapan terpotong, event palsu per 100 ucapan, dan latensi, dengan batas sebelum tiap run.

points.en: Fixed-set retrieval recall at k=4 was 0.909 for English (n=44). The injection guard flagged all 4 retrieved poisoned chunks.
points.id: Recall retrieval set tetap pada k=4 mencapai 0,909 untuk Inggris (n=44). Guard injeksi menandai keempat chunk beracun yang terambil.

limits.en: On-demand evals, not every PR; small samples, no word error rate or real-traffic containment metric. Indonesian retrieval recall remains low: 0.182 (n=11).
limits.id: Evaluasi sesuai kebutuhan, bukan tiap PR; sampel kecil, belum ada word error rate atau containment trafik nyata. Recall retrieval Indonesia masih rendah: 0,182 (n=11).

summary.en: Each app has its own least-privilege managed identity. Database, search, AI and storage key access is disabled; app config holds no data-store keys.
summary.id: Tiap aplikasi memakai managed identity dengan hak minimum. Akses key untuk database, search, AI, dan storage dinonaktifkan; konfigurasi aplikasi tidak menyimpan key data store.

points.en: Service calls use Entra app roles and signed actor context, not shared keys.
points.id: Panggilan antarlayanan memakai Entra app role dan actor context bertanda tangan, bukan key bersama.

points.en: Entra SSO maps groups to roles and fails closed. First-admin binding requires the correct tenant, a member account and verified email.
points.id: Entra SSO memetakan grup ke role secara fail-closed. Admin pertama harus dari tenant yang benar, berstatus member, dan memakai email terverifikasi.

points.en: Anonymous calls get signed, scoped tokens lasting at most 45 minutes. Media tokens are role-scoped; signed webhooks reject replay. Per-install secrets stay in Key Vault. Minimal media images run non-root with the admin API off; signed artifact checks rejected tampering before deployment.
points.id: Panggilan anonim mendapat token bertanda tangan dan terbatas, maksimal 45 menit. Token media dibatasi per role; webhook menolak replay. Secret instalasi disimpan di Key Vault. Image media minimal berjalan non-root tanpa admin API; verifikasi artefak bertanda tangan menolak perubahan ilegal sebelum deploy.

points.en: Ingestion scans every document chunk for prompt injection. Queries exclude quarantined chunks without adding a call-time scan.
points.id: Saat ingestion, tiap chunk diperiksa untuk prompt injection. Query mengecualikan chunk karantina tanpa scan tambahan saat panggilan.

points.en: No audio recording. Post-call transcript PII redaction, per-category retention and data-subject deletion are supported. Every call starts with an uninterruptible AI disclosure, with tools off.
points.id: Audio tidak direkam. Tersedia redaksi PII transkrip setelah panggilan, retensi per kategori, dan penghapusan data subjek. Tiap panggilan dimulai dengan pemberitahuan AI yang tidak bisa dipotong, tanpa tool.

limits.en: Caller identity is unverified. Private endpoints passed a private test install, not customer-production or full call validation. External penetration testing and Marketplace submission remain pending.
limits.id: Identitas penelepon belum diverifikasi. Private endpoint sudah diuji pada test install privat, bukan produksi pelanggan atau validasi panggilan lengkap. Penetration test eksternal dan pengajuan Marketplace masih tertunda.

alt.id: Halaman landing voice agent AI realtime: voice agent realtime dengan jawaban berbasis knowledge dan handoff ke manusia

tagline.en: MII's AI code security platform: seven scanners per pull request, offline rules with source credits, and fixes previewed and rescanned before human review.
tagline.id: Platform keamanan kode berbasis AI milik MII: tujuh scanner per PR, rules offline dengan atribusi sumber, serta preview dan rescan fix sebelum review manusia.

role.en: Creator, sole engineer and operator, responsible for design, AI coding agent direction, review and release
role.id: Pembuat, engineer dan operator tunggal, bertanggung jawab atas desain, arahan AI coding agent, review, dan rilis

problem.en: Across a GitHub organization with 100+ repositories, security scanning needed a consistent place in pull-request review. Engineers needed to understand the findings and inspect proposed fixes before merging, without giving untrusted repository code access to production secrets.
problem.id: Organisasi GitHub dengan 100+ repositori membutuhkan security scanning yang konsisten pada pull request, triage yang jelas, dan perbaikan yang dapat ditinjau dengan aman oleh engineer sebelum merge.

approach.en: I brought the scanners behind one GitHub App, normalized their findings and added exploit-likelihood and known-exploited signals. The November release uses seven engines after removing live-secret verification. I packaged offline rules with upstream credits and hash-locked scanner dependencies so builds can check for drift.
approach.id: Saya menyatukan scanner lewat satu GitHub App, menormalisasi temuan, dan menambahkan sinyal exploit-likelihood serta known-exploited. Rilis November memakai tujuh engine setelah verifikasi secret aktif dihapus. Rules saya kemas untuk pemakaian offline dengan kredit sumber, sementara dependency scanner dikunci beserta hash agar perubahan build terdeteksi.

approach.en: I added Azure OpenAI triage, executive summaries, merge checks and a vector-backed security assistant. A separate read-only AI audit workflow is now merged on main, with coverage tracking and sealed reports, but remains disabled by default; its scripted evaluation is not evidence of live-model accuracy.
approach.id: Saya menambahkan triage Azure OpenAI, ringkasan eksekutif, merge check, dan asisten keamanan berbasis vector index. Workflow audit AI terpisah sudah masuk main, dengan akses read-only, pelacakan cakupan, dan laporan yang disegel. Fitur ini masih default nonaktif; evaluasi dengan model simulasi belum membuktikan akurasi model live.

approach.en: I kept fixes narrow: selected code regions, a token budget and package-manager upgrades without downgrades. The agent checks protected paths, compares scanner results before and after, and reverts rejected changes. Engineers inspect a preview before opening a PR; target-repository builds and tests stay off.
approach.id: Cakupan fix saya batasi pada bagian kode terpilih, dengan token budget dan upgrade lewat package manager tanpa downgrade. Agent memeriksa path sensitif, membandingkan hasil scanner sebelum dan sesudah, lalu membatalkan perubahan yang ditolak. Engineer melihat preview sebelum membuka PR; build dan test repositori target tetap nonaktif.

approach.en: After an internal audit reproduced untrusted repository code executing alongside production secrets, I led a 14-item hardening program. Scans moved to isolated, autoscaled jobs with tokens scoped per job.
approach.id: Audit internal berhasil mereproduksi eksekusi kode repositori tak tepercaya dalam lingkungan yang juga menyimpan secret produksi. Setelah itu, saya memimpin program hardening 14 item dan memindahkan scan ke job terisolasi dengan autoscaling serta token yang dibatasi per job.

approach.en: I added Prompt Shields, prompt-secret redaction and offline injection tests, then released through staging, canaries and health gates (13 releases in 7 days). Earlier Managed Application installs passed 16/16 public and 24/24 private checks; the November tagged release passed 18/18 in a separate Service Catalog install. Those are install checks, not Marketplace approval.
approach.id: Saya menambahkan Prompt Shields, redaksi secret pada prompt, dan test injeksi offline, lalu merilis lewat staging, canary, dan health gate (13 rilis dalam 7 hari). Instalasi Managed Application sebelumnya lolos 16/16 pemeriksaan publik dan 24/24 privat; rilis bertag November lolos 18/18 pada instalasi Service Catalog terpisah. Ini bukti instalasi, bukan persetujuan Marketplace.

situation.en: A GitHub organization with 100+ repositories needed consistent pull-request security scanning, clear triage, and fixes that engineers could review safely before merging. I built MII's AI code security platform for this, as its sole engineer and operator. Every fix had to stay reviewable, and scans of untrusted code had to stay away from production secrets.
situation.id: Organisasi GitHub dengan 100+ repositori membutuhkan security scanning yang konsisten pada pull request, triage yang jelas, dan perbaikan yang dapat ditinjau dengan aman oleh engineer sebelum merge. Untuk kebutuhan ini, saya membangun platform keamanan kode berbasis AI milik MII, sebagai engineer dan operator tunggal. Setiap perbaikan harus tetap dapat ditinjau, dan scan atas kode tak tepercaya harus terpisah dari secret produksi.

title.en: Kept scanner results consistent and their inputs reviewable
title.id: Menjaga konsistensi hasil scanner dan meninjau sumber rules

why.en: Engineers needed findings they could follow across scans, so I normalized outputs and kept identities stable. Later I moved rule inputs offline with source credits and locked scanner dependencies. Adding another engine mattered less than knowing what the existing ones would run.
why.id: Engineer perlu mengikuti temuan yang sama dari satu scan ke scan berikutnya, jadi output saya normalkan dan identitasnya saya jaga. Kemudian rules saya pindahkan ke paket offline dengan kredit sumber, dan dependency scanner saya kunci. Yang penting bukan menambah engine, melainkan mengetahui apa yang dijalankan engine yang sudah ada.

title.en: Kept every fix PR narrow and behind human review
title.id: Membatasi cakupan setiap fix PR dan mewajibkan review manusia

why.en: I wanted the engineer to see a small diff and its validation before publishing. The agent keeps a token budget, guards protected paths, rejects downgrades and compares scanner results before and after. That is static validation, not proof that the repository's build or tests pass.
why.id: Saya ingin engineer melihat diff kecil beserta validasinya sebelum dipublikasikan. Agent dibatasi token budget, menjaga path sensitif, menolak downgrade, dan membandingkan hasil scanner sebelum serta sesudah. Validasi ini bersifat statis, bukan bukti build atau test repositorinya lolos.

title.en: Isolated scans from production secrets after an internal audit
title.id: Mengisolasi scan dari secret produksi setelah audit internal

why.en: The audit reproduced untrusted repository code running alongside production secrets, so I led a 14-item hardening program that moved scans to isolated, autoscaled jobs with tokens scoped per job; the cut-over cost about 9 minutes of outage.
why.id: Audit tersebut berhasil mereproduksi eksekusi kode repositori tak tepercaya dalam lingkungan yang juga menyimpan secret produksi. Saya kemudian memimpin program hardening 14 item, memindahkan scan ke job terisolasi dengan autoscaling dan token yang dibatasi per job. Cut-over ini menimbulkan jeda layanan sekitar 9 menit.

lesson.en: The first deployment needed a written threat model, not just a workaround for limited permissions. A feature flag provided a quick stopgap after the audit, but isolating untrusted code addressed the execution boundary itself.
lesson.id: Buat threat model sejak deploy pertama: menjalankan scan secara inline adalah kompromi yang masuk akal dengan izin yang tersedia, tetapi saat itu juga seharusnya ada threat model tertulis, bukan menunggu audit belakangan. Flag mengurangi risiko dalam hitungan jam; isolasi memperkecil risiko yang tersisa.

summary.en: I made rules and dependencies part of the reviewed release, rather than fetching a changing ruleset at scan time.
summary.id: Rules dan dependency saya masukkan ke rilis yang ditinjau, bukan mengambil ruleset yang bisa berubah saat scan.

points.en: Seven engines remain. Semgrep uses a baked offline ruleset with upstream notices and provenance checks; scanner dependencies are exact, hash-locked and wheel-only.
points.id: Tersisa tujuh engine. Semgrep memakai ruleset offline dalam image, dengan notice sumber dan pemeriksaan asal; dependency scanner dikunci ke versi serta hash tepat, hanya dari wheel.

points.en: The local rule corpus caught 80/80 deliberately seeded cases across 11 languages, versus 45/80 for the former registry pack. This is a regression fixture, not production recall.
points.id: Korpus lokal menangkap 80/80 kasus yang sengaja disisipkan dalam 11 bahasa, dibanding 45/80 paket registry lama. Ini fixture regresi, bukan recall produksi.

points.en: Signed images and manifests are checked during install. The November tagged release passed 18/18 Service Catalog post-install checks, separately from earlier public/private drills.
points.id: Tanda tangan image dan manifest diperiksa saat instalasi. Rilis bertag November lolos 18/18 pemeriksaan Service Catalog, terpisah dari drill publik/privat sebelumnya.

limits.en: No independent scanner-efficacy result or Marketplace approval is established. Secret detection no longer includes live-credential verification.
limits.id: Belum ada hasil efektivitas scanner independen atau persetujuan Marketplace. Deteksi secret tidak lagi memverifikasi kredensial aktif.

summary.en: A proposed change needs a reviewable diff; a source audit needs an honest account of what it did not inspect.
summary.id: Usulan fix harus bisa ditinjau. Audit source juga harus menjelaskan bagian yang belum diperiksa.

points.en: Fixes compare before/after scanner results, reject suppression and protected-path changes, and revert failed units. Preview comes before PR publication; repository builds and tests are disabled.
points.id: Fix membandingkan hasil scanner sebelum/sesudah, menolak suppression serta perubahan path sensitif, dan membatalkan unit gagal. Preview mendahului publikasi PR; build dan test repositori nonaktif.

points.en: The separate AI audit uses bounded read-only tools, a model proxy and sealed reports. Deferred coverage produces an incomplete outcome, not a falsely complete report.
points.id: Audit AI terpisah memakai tool read-only terbatas, proxy model, dan laporan tersegel. Cakupan yang tertunda menghasilkan status belum lengkap, bukan laporan seolah semua sudah diperiksa.

limits.en: The audit is merged on main but disabled by default, with no established live release. Its scripted-model baseline checks plumbing, not live-model accuracy or achieved launch thresholds.
limits.id: Audit sudah masuk main tetapi default nonaktif; rilis live belum terbukti. Baseline model simulasi menguji alur, bukan akurasi model live atau tercapainya ambang peluncuran.

tagline.en: AI document fraud review: OCR and two-pass LLM procurement review, with offline development-set evaluation. The hybrid engine remains in shadow mode only.
tagline.id: Review fraud dokumen berbasis AI: OCR dan LLM dua tahap untuk pengadaan. Evaluasi memakai set development offline; engine hybrid tetap di shadow mode.

role.en: Creator and sole engineer, responsible for design, AI coding agent direction, review and release
role.id: Pembuat dan engineer tunggal, bertanggung jawab atas desain, arahan AI coding agent, review, dan rilis

problem.en: Procurement teams needed fraud review they could trust across a packet of documents. Early versions flagged clean packets too often. Reducing that noise was not enough: a release still had to meet the recall gate.
problem.id: Tim pengadaan membutuhkan review fraud yang cepat dan dapat dipercaya untuk paket dokumen. Versi awal menandai paket bersih sebagai bermasalah, sehingga mengurangi kepercayaan terhadap hasilnya.

approach.en: I built a two-pass pipeline over OCR output: per-document findings followed by a cross-document verdict, with live progress streaming. In Oct 2026 I rebuilt its UI in English and Indonesian: a Home that leads with cases needing attention, a three-step analysis wizard and a phone-to-desktop pass with 0 axe violations.
approach.id: Saya membangun pipeline dua tahap dari hasil OCR: temuan per dokumen, lalu verdict lintas dokumen, dengan progres yang di-stream secara live. Pada Okt 2026, saya membangun ulang UI-nya dalam bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia: Home yang mendahulukan kasus yang perlu perhatian, wizard analisis tiga langkah, dan pengecekan dari ponsel hingga desktop dengan 0 pelanggaran axe.

approach.en: I moved prompts into declarative YAML agents on Microsoft Agent Framework, keeping the agent definitions explicit rather than embedded in the pipeline code.
approach.id: Saya memindahkan prompt ke YAML agent deklaratif menggunakan Microsoft Agent Framework.

approach.en: I established gold sets and CI gates for false-positive rate, recall and fail-open, then replaced the majority-vote guardrail and overly broad safe patterns.
approach.id: Saya menyusun gold set dan CI gate untuk false-positive rate, recall, dan fail-open, lalu mengganti guardrail majority vote serta safe pattern yang terlalu luas.

approach.en: I designed a hybrid rules and LLM risk engine with a rules catalog, severity floors, an evidence verifier and duplicate fingerprints. It failed the recall gate, so I kept it in shadow mode.
approach.id: Saya merancang risk engine hybrid berbasis rules dan LLM dengan katalog rules, severity floor, evidence verifier, dan fingerprint duplikat. Karena gagal di recall gate, engine tetap saya jalankan hanya dalam shadow mode.

approach.en: After a secret-exposure incident, I purged git history, rotated two keys without downtime and moved to Key Vault references. I later packaged the product as a single-organization Managed Application with keyless services and signed, digest-pinned releases. A November test install and redeploy passed the recorded checks; Marketplace submission and human sign-in checks remained open, and malware scanning was not active in that install.
approach.id: Setelah insiden secret terekspos, saya membersihkan git history, merotasi dua key tanpa downtime, dan memakai Key Vault reference. Berikutnya saya mengemas produk sebagai Managed Application satu organisasi, dengan layanan keyless serta rilis bertanda tangan yang dikunci ke digest. Test install dan redeploy November lolos pemeriksaan tercatat, tetapi pengajuan Marketplace serta sign-in langsung belum selesai, dan malware scanning belum aktif pada instalasi itu.

context.en: The fixed synthetic comparison profile checked shadow isolation, not production volume or accuracy. Offline development FPR fell to 9.1% but recall to 0.841; held-out recall was 0.429. The hybrid engine remains shadow-only.
context.id: Profil perbandingan sintetis tetap ini menguji isolasi shadow, bukan volume atau akurasi produksi. FPR development offline turun ke 9,1%, tetapi recall ke 0,841; recall held-out 0,429. Engine hybrid tetap hanya di shadow mode.

context.id: Evaluasi live setelah pergantian model; false positive juga turun dari 26,1% menjadi 21,7%. Ini hasil evaluasi, bukan hasil produksi.

situation.en: Procurement teams needed to review evidence across document packets, but early versions of the AI document fraud review platform flagged clean packets too often. As its creator and sole engineer, I needed to reduce false positives without losing high-risk cases in the evaluation set. A lower false-positive rate alone would not justify release.
situation.id: Tim pengadaan membutuhkan review fraud yang cepat dan dapat dipercaya untuk paket dokumen. Versi awal menandai paket bersih sebagai bermasalah, sehingga mengurangi kepercayaan terhadap hasilnya. Sebagai pembuat dan engineer tunggal platform review fraud dokumen berbasis AI, saya harus membuktikan bahwa false positive bisa turun tanpa melewatkan fraud yang sebenarnya.

title.en: Split review into per-document findings and a cross-document verdict
title.id: Memisahkan review menjadi temuan per dokumen dan verdict lintas dokumen

why.en: The pipeline runs over OCR output: the first pass records findings for each document, the second pass reaches a verdict across the documents, and live progress streams while it runs.
why.id: Pipeline memproses hasil OCR dalam dua tahap: tahap pertama mencatat temuan per dokumen, lalu tahap kedua menghasilkan verdict lintas dokumen. Progres di-stream secara live selama proses berjalan.

title.en: Gated changes on gold sets for false positives, recall and fail-open
title.id: Menguji setiap perubahan dengan gold set untuk false positive, recall, dan fail-open

why.en: A cleaner-looking report could still miss a high-risk case. I set release gates for false-positive rate, recall and fail-open before changing the majority-vote guardrail and overly broad safe patterns.
why.id: Saya lebih dulu menyusun gold set dan CI gate untuk false-positive rate, recall, dan fail-open, lalu mengganti guardrail majority vote serta safe pattern yang terlalu luas.

title.en: Kept the hybrid risk engine in shadow mode after it failed recall
title.id: Mempertahankan risk engine hybrid di shadow mode setelah gagal di recall gate

why.en: Offline false positives fell to 9.1%, but recall dropped to 0.841; held-out recall was 0.429. I kept the engine out of the verdict path. A separate isolation check changed no legacy verdict or score in 3,780 synthetic offline runs; that was not production traffic or proof of accuracy.
why.id: False positive offline turun ke 9,1%, tetapi recall menjadi 0,841 dan hanya 0,429 di held-out. Saya tetap tidak memberi engine kendali verdict. Uji isolasi sintetis offline tidak mengubah verdict atau skor lama; itu bukan trafik produksi atau bukti akurasi.

lesson.en: Write the release gates before running the evaluation; if a change fails a gate, it does not become the decision maker, even when another number looks better. One good development run is encouraging, but it is not the bar for letting the engine decide.
lesson.id: Tulis release gate sebelum menjalankan evaluasi; jika perubahan gagal di salah satu gate, jangan gunakan perubahan itu untuk menentukan keputusan, meskipun angka lain terlihat lebih baik. Satu run development yang bagus memang menggembirakan, tetapi belum cukup untuk menjadikan engine penentu verdict.

summary.en: I kept a lower false-positive rate from becoming permission to miss more high-risk packets.
summary.id: Penurunan false positive tidak saya jadikan alasan untuk menerima lebih banyak paket berisiko yang terlewat.

points.en: Rules, severity floors and evidence checks produce a traceable shadow score. The live two-pass LLM pipeline still owns the user-visible verdict.
points.id: Rules, severity floor, dan pemeriksaan bukti menghasilkan skor shadow yang bisa ditelusuri. Verdict pengguna tetap berasal dari pipeline LLM dua tahap.

points.en: Hybrid recall was 0.841 on development and 0.429 on held-out. Its 3,780-run synthetic offline isolation check showed unchanged legacy output, not accuracy or real-case volume.
points.id: Recall hybrid mencapai 0,841 di development dan 0,429 di held-out. Uji isolasi 3.780 run sintetis offline menunjukkan output lama tidak berubah, bukan akurasi atau volume kasus nyata.

points.en: A later framework upgrade passed a separate gate after streamed-output fixes and five repeats on 41 cases. That approval did not qualify the hybrid engine for cutover.
points.id: Upgrade framework berikutnya lolos gate terpisah setelah perbaikan output streaming dan lima pengulangan pada 41 kasus. Kelulusan itu bukan izin cutover engine hybrid.

limits.en: Small development/held-out sets, no established production accuracy or reviewer-agreement result. Hybrid cutover remains blocked; repeated runs do not add independent cases.
limits.id: Set development/held-out kecil, tanpa bukti akurasi produksi atau kesesuaian dengan reviewer. Cutover hybrid tetap diblokir; run berulang bukan kasus independen tambahan.

summary.en: Install checks need to show what is protected and what is merely configured.
summary.id: Pemeriksaan instalasi harus membedakan proteksi yang sudah aktif dari yang baru dikonfigurasi.

points.en: The Managed Application path uses Container Apps, keyless data/AI access and signed, digest-pinned artifacts verified before import and redeploy. The older App Service path remains a separate deployment.
points.id: Jalur Managed Application memakai Container Apps, akses data/AI keyless, dan artefak bertanda tangan yang dikunci ke digest, diverifikasi sebelum import serta redeploy. Jalur App Service lama adalah deployment terpisah.

points.en: Organization-level pseudonymization can tokenize model inputs and rehydrate results server-side. Unavailable settings fail closed before model calls; only offline/simulated checks were established.
points.id: Pseudonymization per organisasi dapat mengganti identitas di input model dengan token dan memulihkan hasil di server. Setting yang tidak tersedia menghentikan panggilan model; bukti pengujiannya baru offline/simulasi.

limits.en: Pseudonymization still needs live paired validation. Malware scanning was inactive in the recorded install. Human sign-in checks and Marketplace submission remain open; install success is not a launch.
limits.id: Pseudonymization masih perlu validasi live berpasangan. Malware scanning belum aktif pada instalasi tercatat. Uji sign-in langsung dan pengajuan Marketplace belum selesai; instalasi berhasil bukan berarti sudah diluncurkan.

tagline.en: AI CV screening: ~45% failures in the original 22-pair screening run; no recorded rerun. AI supplies evidence; the recruiter makes the final decision.
tagline.id: Screening CV berbasis AI: kegagalan ~45% pada run awal 22 pasang, tanpa rerun tercatat. AI memberikan bukti; recruiter tetap mengambil keputusan akhir.

role.en: Creator and lead engineer, responsible for evaluation decisions
role.id: Pembuat dan lead engineer, bertanggung jawab atas keputusan evaluasi

problem.en: The CV screening system had two problems: model calls frequently failed, and successful calls could still produce hire-or-reject verdicts without evidence. With no tests or release gates, prompt and model changes could make either problem worse without being caught.
problem.id: Screening CV pelamar berbasis LLM sering gagal dan memberikan keputusan terima atau tolak tanpa bukti. Belum ada test atau release gate untuk mendeteksi regresi akibat perubahan prompt maupun model.

approach.en: I traced two production errors to token exhaustion mid-JSON and raw newlines in strings, then addressed them with JSON mode, output caps, a quote-aware extractor and retries.
approach.id: Saya menemukan dua penyebab error produksi: token habis di tengah JSON dan newline mentah dalam string. Keduanya saya atasi dengan JSON mode, batas output, extractor yang mengenali tanda kutip, dan retry.

approach.en: I introduced the first test suite and CI-gated evaluation harness, using a 40-pair golden set (37.5% in Bahasa Indonesia), counterfactual fairness checks and 20+ prompt-injection classes.
approach.id: Saya menambahkan test suite pertama dan evaluation harness dengan CI gate, menggunakan golden set 40 pasang (37,5% berbahasa Indonesia), pengecekan fairness counterfactual, dan 20+ kelas prompt injection.

approach.en: I removed AI hire-or-reject verdicts, added disclosure and a system card, and redacted identity before model calls. I led the bilingual redesign around fit bands, requirement coverage and one evidence summary, leaving the decision to the recruiter. AI coding agents helped implement it; a teammate contributed menu and tab work. Routes were checked for axe, overflow and 44 px touch targets.
approach.id: Saya menghapus verdict terima atau tolak dari AI, menambahkan disclosure serta system card, dan meredaksi identitas sebelum pemanggilan model. Redesign bilingual saya arahkan ke fit band, cakupan persyaratan, dan satu ringkasan bukti; recruiter tetap memutuskan. AI coding agent membantu implementasi, sementara rekan saya berkontribusi pada menu dan tab. Route diperiksa dengan axe, pengecekan overflow, dan target sentuh 44 px.

approach.en: I adopted passwordless managed identity and HMAC-signed calls between the web tier and backend.
approach.id: Saya menerapkan managed identity tanpa password dan panggilan bertanda tangan HMAC antara web tier dan backend.

approach.en: I packaged it as a single-organization Managed Application, with a private-network option behind Front Door WAF, and fixed 12 install findings. November work added private artifact delivery, revocable read credentials, pinned publisher controls and plan-capacity enforcement. Signature/hash checks and negative install tests passed; sign-in, real screening, metering acceptance and upgrade/rollback in that installation remain unproven.
approach.id: Saya mengemasnya sebagai Managed Application satu organisasi, dengan opsi jaringan privat di belakang Front Door WAF, lalu memperbaiki 12 temuan instalasi. Pada November saya menambahkan distribusi artefak privat, kredensial baca yang bisa dicabut, kontrol publisher terkunci, dan batas kapasitas per plan. Verifikasi signature/hash serta test negatif instalasi lolos; sign-in, screening nyata, penerimaan metering, dan upgrade/rollback di instalasi itu belum terbukti.

label.en: Failure rate, original 22-pair screening run; no recorded rerun
label.id: Tingkat kegagalan screening awal, 22 pasang; belum ada rerun yang tercatat

context.en: Observed in a 22-pair evaluation run, with fixes covered by 7 regression tests from real error strings. A rerun of that exact evaluation was not recorded.
context.id: Teramati pada run evaluasi 22 pasang, dengan perbaikan diuji melalui 7 regression test dari pesan error asli. Rerun evaluasi yang persis sama tidak tercatat.

label.en: Parse failure in a later offline synthetic baseline (1 of 800 calls)
label.id: Parse failure pada baseline sintetis offline berikutnya (1 dari 800 panggilan)

context.en: After retries, using a newer model and prompt on synthetic offline inputs, without human reference labels or production sampling. Not a before/after estimate of the original fixes.
context.id: Setelah retry, memakai model dan prompt lebih baru pada input sintetis offline, tanpa label referensi manusia atau sampling produksi. Bukan pengukuran sebelum/sesudah perbaikan awal.

label.en: Test files added from a zero-test baseline, with evaluation gates blocking deploys
label.id: File test yang ditambahkan dari kondisi tanpa test, dengan evaluation gate yang memblokir deploy

context.en: Based on repository history.
context.id: Berdasarkan riwayat repositori.

label.en: Screening p95 in controlled offline evaluations, high to medium reasoning
label.id: P95 screening pada evaluasi offline terkontrol, reasoning high ke medium

context.en: Controlled offline synthetic rounds, not production latency. Medium passed the recorded fairness and injection gates; limited samples do not establish fairness across all groups.
context.id: Putaran sintetis offline terkontrol, bukan latensi produksi. Medium lolos gate fairness dan injection tercatat; sampel terbatas belum membuktikan fairness untuk semua kelompok.

summary.en: I separated a parser fix from proof that the original screening batch had recovered.
summary.id: Perbaikan parser saya bedakan dari bukti bahwa batch screening awal sudah pulih.

points.en: JSON mode, output caps, quote-aware extraction and bounded retries address the two recorded failures. Seven regressions cover real error strings; the original 22-pair batch has no recorded rerun.
points.id: JSON mode, batas output, ekstraksi yang mengenali kutip, dan retry terbatas menangani dua kegagalan tercatat. Tujuh test regresi memakai pesan error asli; batch 22 pasangan awal belum punya rerun tercatat.

points.en: The later 1/800 parse-failure baseline used a newer model and prompt. The 40-pair golden set, counterfactual checks and injection suite gate changes, not hiring decisions.
points.id: Baseline parse failure 1/800 berikutnya memakai model dan prompt baru. Golden set 40 pasangan, counterfactual check, dan suite injeksi membatasi rilis perubahan, bukan mengambil keputusan rekrutmen.

limits.en: Offline synthetic evaluation, without human reference labels or production sampling. Some fairness strata remain too small/noisy to bound. The recruiter remains the decision maker.
limits.id: Evaluasi sintetis offline, tanpa label referensi manusia atau sampling produksi. Sebagian strata fairness masih terlalu kecil/noisy untuk dibatasi. Recruiter tetap mengambil keputusan.

summary.en: I made release delivery refuse bad credentials and changed artifacts, not just succeed on the happy path.
summary.id: Distribusi rilis saya uji agar menolak kredensial tidak sah dan artefak berubah, bukan hanya berhasil pada alur normal.

points.en: Private release storage uses revocable read credentials. Installation verifies the signed manifest, release identity and pinned hashes before importing artifacts; forged/revoked credentials and tampered hashes were rejected.
points.id: Storage rilis privat memakai kredensial baca yang bisa dicabut. Installer memverifikasi manifest bertanda tangan, identitas rilis, dan hash terkunci sebelum import; kredensial palsu/dicabut serta hash yang diubah berhasil ditolak.

points.en: Plan-specific packages pin publisher settings and enforce hard capacity limits separately from AI guardrails and usage accounting. Installed-package checks rejected publisher-setting overrides.
points.id: Paket per plan mengunci setting publisher dan menerapkan batas kapasitas terpisah dari guardrail AI serta pencatatan usage. Uji paket terpasang menolak override setting publisher.

limits.en: Read credentials cover a container, not only one release. Automated install checks do not prove sign-in, real screening, metering acceptance or upgrade/rollback. No Marketplace listing is established.
limits.id: Kredensial baca mencakup container, bukan hanya satu rilis. Test instalasi otomatis belum membuktikan sign-in, screening nyata, penerimaan metering, atau upgrade/rollback. Listing Marketplace belum tersedia.

alt.id: Pipeline lowongan dengan tile per tahap, pemberitahuan integrity review, dan daftar kandidat dengan fit band serta must-have yang terpenuhi; nama kandidat diganti

alt.id: Hasil kandidat: must-have dan requirement yang terpenuhi, pemberitahuan AI sebagai pendukung keputusan, fit band, cakupan requirement, dan panel keputusan tempat recruiter memutuskan

alt.id: Screening run yang selesai: 24 dari 24 kandidat di-screening, tidak ada yang gagal, tabel kandidat, dan feed aktivitas

tagline.en: Document AI for a national digital bank's evaluators, with strict access control, data at rest in an Indonesian Azure region and faster document processing.
tagline.id: Document AI untuk evaluator sebuah bank digital nasional, dengan kontrol akses ketat, data at rest di region Azure Indonesia, dan pemrosesan dokumen yang lebih cepat.

role.id: Lead engineer, bertanggung jawab atas pemeliharaan

problem.en: A national digital bank needed an auditable bank-statement analysis PoC within a fixed evaluation window. The environment had to protect both uploads and results, keep data at rest in Indonesia and be ready for evaluators, not just a demo.
problem.id: Evaluator dari sebuah bank digital nasional membutuhkan analisis rekening koran yang bisa diaudit dalam periode PoC yang ditetapkan. Upload dan hasil analisis memerlukan kontrol akses ketat, dengan data at rest tetap tersimpan di Indonesia.

approach.en: I built the platform and infrastructure as code in a fixed Indonesian Azure region.
approach.id: Saya membangun platform dan infrastructure as code dengan region Azure yang ditetapkan di Indonesia.

approach.en: I hardened sign-in with Entra OIDC, PKCE, JWKS verification and fail-closed role mapping, then added maker-checker controls, audit trails and three-language support.
approach.id: Saya memperkuat sign-in dengan Entra OIDC, PKCE, verifikasi JWKS, dan role mapping fail-closed, lalu menambahkan kontrol maker-checker, audit trail, dan dukungan tiga bahasa.

approach.en: I fixed critical defects before evaluator access: an SSO role-mapping flaw, an inverted CSRF check behind the platform proxy and demo paths capable of fabricating analysis.
approach.id: Saya memperbaiki bug kritis sebelum evaluator mendapat akses: celah role mapping SSO, pengecekan CSRF yang terbalik di balik proxy platform, dan jalur demo yang dapat menghasilkan analisis palsu.

approach.en: I enforced team rules through build-time verifier scripts, bounded the document-processing page pool and contributed to the PoC technical proposal.
approach.id: Saya menerapkan aturan tim melalui verifier script saat build, membatasi page pool pemrosesan dokumen, dan berkontribusi pada proposal teknis PoC.

label.en: Document processing: mean run 233.9 s to 186.8 s; slowest run -34%
label.id: Pemrosesan dokumen: rata-rata run 233,9 detik menjadi 186,8 detik; run terlama -34%

context.en: Replay benchmark over 4 runs with data stores wiped clean; all 4 retained 99.3 to 99.4% analysis confidence, with accuracy unchanged.
context.id: Replay benchmark sebanyak 4 run pada data store yang dikosongkan; keempatnya mempertahankan confidence analisis 99,3 hingga 99,4%, dengan akurasi tidak berubah.

label.en: Automated tests supported by 34 invariant verifier scripts
label.id: Automated test dengan dukungan 34 invariant verifier script

context.en: Enforced during builds and checked with mutation testing.
context.id: Dijalankan sebagai syarat build dan diperiksa dengan mutation testing.

label.en: Bank evaluators representing 3 personas used the environment
label.id: Evaluator bank yang mewakili 3 persona menggunakan environment ini

context.en: Used during hands-on PoC evaluation; the outcome is not public.
context.id: Digunakan selama evaluasi PoC secara langsung; hasil akhirnya tidak dipublikasikan.

alt.id: Dashboard analisis rekening koran: exposure yang dianalisis, rekening koran yang diproses, dokumen berisiko tinggi, dan antrean kerja; nominal dan nama diburamkan

alt.id: Daftar pengajuan kredit dengan status, analis, jumlah dokumen, dan status analisis; nama debitur dan analis diburamkan
